entities.summary: Momir Korunović, was a Serbian architect associated with Serbo-Byzantine Revival. He was sometimes called the 'Serbian Gaudi'. Although he designed many buildings in Belgrade and Yugoslavia between the two World Wars, he is largely forgotten today. Many of his works were destroyed or substantially altered during World War II and the communist period. Momir Korunović was a architects & engineers from Glogovac (1883, Glogovac–1969-04-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
